videos.caption: AIR FRYER CHICKEN FAJITA BOWLS Need an easy high-protein meal prep? Make these Air Fryer Chicken Fajita Bowls with chicken, four bell peppers, red onion, rice, and fajita seasoning. Makes 4 Servings Per Serving: Calories: ~575 Protein: ~55g Carbohydrates: ~65g Fat: ~10g Ingredients: * 2 lb chicken breast * 1 red bell pepper * 1 yellow bell pepper * 1 orange bell pepper * 1 green bell pepper * 1 red onion * 2 packets fajita seasoning * 1 tbsp lime juice * Cooking spray * 1⅓ cups dry white rice * 1⅔ cups water Instructions: Dice the chicken, peppers, and onion. Toss with fajita seasoning and lime juice. Air fry at 400°F for 14–16 minutes, tossing halfway through. Cook the rice separately and divide everything evenly into 4 meal prep containers. Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Sweet & Sticky Chicken 🍯🌶️ Easy high-protein meal prep that tastes ridiculously good and makes 8 big serves. Ingredients * 2 kg chicken thighs, diced * 1 kg cooked jasmine rice * 150 ml sweet chilli sauce * 100 ml honey * 100 ml soy sauce * Garlic powder * Smoked paprika * Spring onions Method 1. Season the chicken with garlic powder and smoked paprika, then cook until browned and cooked through. 2. Add the sweet chilli sauce, honey and soy sauce. 3. Cook everything down until the sauce becomes thick and sticky. 4. Divide the rice and sweet & sticky chicken between 8 containers. 5. Finish with sliced spring onions. Makes 8 serves Per serve: approx. 630 calories | 52g protein | 65g carbs | 18g fat

Classic Herb Chicken Meal Prep Bowl Ingredients: 2 chicken breasts 1 cup broccoli florets 1 sweet potato, diced 1 avocado, sliced 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp mixed herbs Salt & black pepper Instructions: Season chicken with olive oil, herbs, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Grill or bake chicken at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes. Roast sweet potato cubes until crispy. Steam broccoli until tender. Slice cooked chicken. Arrange chicken, broccoli, sweet potato, and avocado in a bowl. Serve fresh or store for meal prep. 2. Lemon Pepper Chicken Meal Prep Bowl Ingredients: 2 chicken breasts 1 cup cooked quinoa 1 cup green beans 1 carrot, sliced 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp lemon pepper seasoning 1 tbsp olive oil Salt to taste Instructions: Rub chicken with olive oil, lemon juice, and lemon pepper seasoning. Cook chicken in a pan or oven until fully done. Cook quinoa according to package instructions. Sauté green beans and carrots lightly. Slice chicken into strips. Add quinoa, vegetables, and chicken to the bowl. Garnish with lemon slices and serve. 3. BBQ Chicken Meal Prep Bowl Ingredients: 2 chicken breasts 1 cup brown rice 1 cup roasted corn 1 red bell pepper, diced ½ cup BBQ sauce 1 tbsp olive oil Salt & pepper Instructions: Marinate chicken with BBQ sauce, salt, and pepper. Grill or bake chicken until juicy and cooked through. Cook brown rice until soft. Roast corn and bell peppers in a pan with olive oil. Slice BBQ chicken. Arrange rice, corn, bell peppers, and chicken in the bowl. Drizzle extra BBQ sauce before serving. 4. Garlic Butter Chicken Meal Prep Bowl Ingredients: 2 chicken breasts or chicken bites 1 cup cauliflower rice 1 bunch asparagus 1 cup cherry tomatoes 2 tbsp butter 4 garlic cloves, minced Salt, pepper, and parsley Instructions: Heat butter in a pan and sauté garlic until fragrant. Add chicken and cook until golden brown. Sauté asparagus and cherry tomatoes lightly. Cook cauliflower rice for 3–4 minutes. Season everything with salt, pepper, and parsley. Arrange chicken, vegetables, and cauliflower rice in bowls. Serve warm or refrigerate for meal prep. #food #recipe #usa #foodie #comfortfood
